repository.name: webex
repository.purpose: The webex npm package of the Webex JS SDK. Its entry files require plugin packages for their side effects and extend the webex-core WebexCore constructor, giving a full Webex constructor (main export), a meetings constructor (webex/meetings), a Calling wrapper around an SDK instance (webex/calling), and encryption and first-party variants. It also selects storage adapters per platform, ships Node and browser helper files, and carries committed UMD bundles.

webex-sdk.summary: Published npm package webex. main is dist/index.js and devMain is src/index.js. exports maps . to dist/index.js, ./calling to dist/calling.js, ./meetings to dist/meetings.js, and ./package to package.json. The browser field maps config-storage to config-storage.shim in dist and src. Per-entry behavior is in src/docs/README.md. The exports map has no ./env, ./encryption, or ./webex-first-party entry.

webex-umd-bundles.summary: Committed minified bundles webex, webex-first-party, meetings, encryption, and calling with source maps, built by the workspace root webpack config with the umd flag. Globals: Webex for all but calling, which exposes Calling from its default export.

webex-core-plugin-host.summary: WebexCore.extend gives each entry its constructor; initialize merges config; plugin packages register on one registry per loaded webex-core copy, kept on the WebexCore and WebexInternalCore prototypes, where the first registration of a name wins unless replace is passed. Request, credentials, services, and storage behavior are owned by webex-core.

webex-public-plugins.source: @webex/plugin-* workspace packages listed in package.json dependencies
webex-public-plugins.summary: Required for their registration side effect: plugin-authorization (or plugin-authorization-browser-first-party), plugin-attachment-actions, plugin-device-manager, plugin-encryption, plugin-logger, plugin-meetings, plugin-memberships, plugin-messages, plugin-people, plugin-rooms, plugin-team-memberships, plugin-teams, and plugin-webhooks. Each plugin's behavior is owned by its package.

webex-internal-plugins.summary: Required for their registration side effect: internal-plugin-calendar, -device, -dss, -llm, -mercury, -presence, -support, -task, and -voicea (declared), plus internal-plugin-encryption, -metrics, and -user (required by src/ but not declared in package.json). Calling uses webex.internal.device and webex.internal.mercury.

webex-calling-sdk.summary: src/calling.js imports the namespace and uses Logger, createClient, createContactsClient, createCallHistoryClient, createVoicemailClient, createCallSettingsClient, createCallRecordingClient, createMicrophoneStream, and NoiseReductionEffect.

webex-contact-center-sdk.summary: Required by src/webex.js for its registration side effect only.

storage-adapter-local-storage.summary: src/config-storage.shim.js constructs LocalStorageStoreAdapter with namespace webex for bounded storage in browsers.

babel-polyfill.summary: Required by the guarded entry files when global._babelPolyfill is not set.

lodash.summary: lodash/merge builds the init config in src/webex.js, src/meetings.js, src/encryption.js, and src/calling.js.

No security policy file exists in this package or at the workspace root. Stage 0 creates none; a policy is a governance decision outside this package's annotation.
Contribution instructions are owned at the workspace root and linked from this package README.md.

The CTO readiness checklist applies to deployable services. This package is a library.
